articles.summary: Camera, microphone, and screen recording permissions can now be set to optional instead of required. When a permission is optional, participants are prompted to enable it but can skip and continue if they'd rather not, so you can collect richer data without blocking participants who can't or won't grant access. Available for all unmoderated studies; not available for AI-moderated studies. Fixes: skip logic now works correctly in User Interviews studies; multi-select questions with 'any of these' ideal answers now qualify correctly when a participant selects just one of them; auto-disqualification now works in User Interviews, matching how it behaves in Great Question.
